generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, these genres are the working documents of your study in the School of Sport. Your dissertation opens with a literature review; a study begins as a proposal a supervisor and an ethics panel approve; findings are written up as a report. Across sport science, coaching, management and therapy alike, each time you write one to its purpose, rather than merely to its format, you are doing the work that research in sport is built on.
